scripts.dev: npm run build:package && npm run dev:preview
scripts.build: npm run build:package && npm run build:preview
scripts.build:package: npm run build:bundle && npm run build:types
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:package && npm run typecheck:preview
scripts.lint: npm run lint:package && npm run lint:preview
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:package && npm run lint:fix:preview
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:server && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.pack:check: npm run typecheck:package && npm run lint:package && npm run check:server && npm run test && npm run build:package && npm pack ./package --dry-run
scripts.docs:fill: tsc package/src/scripts/doc_filling.ts --target ES2020 --module ES2020 --moduleResolution node --types node --skipLibCheck --outDir package/.docs-tmp && node package/.docs-tmp/doc_filling.js package/src && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('package/.docs-tmp',{recursive:true,force:true})"
